recommendation: Keep the audit commit and do not re-add the extension definition or Patient extension listing to core. Future changes to this extension should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack.
issue_request: FHIR-25401 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core and asked for a standard no-fixed-address extension on the Address datatype, reusing the Australian extension structure with an HL7 FHIR URL.
initial_application: PA approved the request at the 2021 May WGM. Core commit 0bcf5a628352f8e84a7dc1d3fac6fa9bca0cbe1b added source/patient/structuredefinition-extension-no-fixed-address.xml and listed StructureDefinition/no-fixed-address in source/patient/implementationguide-Patient-core.xml.
additional_context: Core commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 later removed extension definitions and extension IG entries from R5 core source. The FHIR Extension Pack states that globally defined extensions moved out of core starting with R5, and its current no-fixed-address StructureDefinition has Address context. FHIR-53014 later removed Patient from the extension name/title.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No FHIR core source change is needed because the current extension definition is maintained in HL7/fhir-extensions.

related_jiras.note: Later Published FHIR-core request for the same no-fixed-address extension, applied in the same core commit.
FHIR-extensions issue that removed Patient from the current extension name and title.
